title: EgoHumanoid-V2: Human-to-Humanoid Transfer of Coordinated Whole-Body Skills for Loco-Manipulation
abstract: arXiv:2609.37181v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Human demonstrations capture diverse scenes and rich whole-body skills without requiring robot teleoperation. Prior work on egocentric transfer has emphasized scene generalization in loco-manipulation under decoupled control, leaving direct transfer of coordinated whole-body skills less explored. We present EgoHumanoid-V2, the first egocentric human-to-humanoid skill transfer framework for coordinated whole-body loco-manipulation. At its core, coarse-to-fine action alignment combines kinematic reference correction with dynamics-aware refinement. It improves end-effector pose accuracy while preserving whole-body coordination. We also use robot-arm rendering and training-time image augmentation to reduce the visual embodiment gap and improve viewpoint robustness. On four real-world tasks, vision-language-action (VLA) policies trained on aligned human data show zero-shot skill transfer without target-task robot demonstrations. Task scores

translated_title: EgoHumanoid-V2：面向移动操作的人到人形机器人全身协调技能迁移
translated_abstract: 人类演示无需机器人遥操作即可捕捉多样化场景和丰富的全身技能。以往关于第一人称视角迁移的工作主要关注解耦控制下移动操作的场景泛化，而对协调性全身技能的直接迁移探索较少。我们提出了EgoHumanoid-V2，这是首个用于协调性全身移动操作的第一人称视角人到人形机器人技能迁移框架。其核心是由粗到细的动作对齐方法，将运动学参考校正与动力学感知的精细化相结合，在提升末端执行器位姿精度的同时保持全身协调性。我们还采用机械臂渲染和训练时图像增强来缩小视觉形态差距并提高视角鲁棒性。在四项真实世界任务中，基于对齐人类数据训练的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略展现出了无需目标任务机器人演示的零样本技能迁移能力。
tldr: 提出首个第一人称视角的人到人形机器人技能迁移框架EgoHumanoid-V2，通过由粗到细的动作对齐（结合运动学参考校正与动力学感知精细化）以及机械臂渲染和图像增强缩小视觉形态差距，使VLA策略仅凭人类演示数据即可在真实任务上实现零样本全身协调技能迁移。
en_tdlr: EgoHumanoid-V2 presents the first egocentric human-to-humanoid skill transfer framework for coordinated whole-body loco-manipulation, using coarse-to-fine action alignment (kinematic reference correction with dynamics-aware refinement) and robot-arm rendering with image augmentation to bridge the visual embodiment gap, enabling zero-shot transfer of VLA policies trained solely on aligned human data.
